title: GATE ME
90 DAYS
scenes.voice: Preparing for GATE twenty twenty-seven, Mechanical? We are starting a ninety day challenge, and you are invited.

scenes.title: Every Day You Get
scenes.voice: Every day you get the topic at eight A. M., a free practice set with full solutions on Telegram, a test at seven P. M., and the top scorers featured in the next reel.

scenes.title: How to Join
scenes.voice: To take the tests, enrol once in the challenge course on the Dig Career Thrust app or website. It costs just one rupee, and all ninety tests are included.

scenes.title: Mark Your Calendar
scenes.voice: Ninety days. Day one is Monday, nineteenth October. Comment GATE ninety and we will send you all the links.
